answer.main_body: chain-link fence frame with concrete base
answer.evidence: The fence frame is drawn in flat front elevation. The top horizontal rail consists only of horizontal stripes with a 1px highlight line (rows 3-5) rather than a foreshortened top surface seen from above, and the post has no visible top.

answer.main_body: wire mesh fence with concrete base
answer.evidence: The top green horizontal beam has no visible top surface (only a 1px edge highlight on row 3) and is rendered in pure front elevation. The fence structure lacks top-down depth.

The concrete base clearly displays a foreshortened top surface (rows 22-26, 5 rows tall) with the fence slotted into its groove, transitioning at row 26-27 to the darker south-facing front face (rows 27-31).

answer.main_body: wire mesh fence with green pipe frame on concrete base
answer.evidence: The main fence frame and top horizontal pipe (rows 2-6) are rendered in pure front elevation with simple 1px cylinder shading (rows 3-5) and no top surface shown from above. For a frame object, horizontal beams must show visible top faces.
